# E&P Systems

> Bilingual AI agency in Sofia, Bulgaria. We build AI websites, AI automations, AI agents, AI SEO systems, and AI e-commerce stacks for businesses serving Bulgaria and the European Union. Founded in 2024 by Emil Dermendzhiev and Pavel Stefanov. Our default stack is n8n + Anthropic's Claude API integrated with whatever tools the client already runs (Google Workspace, CRMs, Shopify/WooCommerce, WhatsApp Business, Stripe).

We specialize in three industries: insurance brokers, e-commerce, and fitness. We work in both Bulgarian and English; every page exists in both languages and Bulgarian is the primary (x-default) version. All pages are served as static HTML, so their full text, FAQ answers and JSON-LD are readable without executing JavaScript.

Last updated: 2026-09-01.

## Languages

## Pricing (starting points, EUR)

Full table and FAQ: https://www.epsystems.org/en/pricing (BG: https://www.epsystems.org/bg/pricing). All prices are starting points; the final quote depends on scope. No hidden fees.

- Websites: from €199 (single page), €449 (up to 5 pages, CMS), €549 (custom bilingual multi-page, monthly post-launch support)
- Online stores: from €199 (up to 50 products, Shopify/WooCommerce), €499 (up to 500 products, custom storefront, email flows), €599 (custom platform, multi-currency)
- SEO retainers: €299/month (on-page, up to 10 keywords), €599/month (on- and off-page, up to 30 keywords), €1,199/month (full strategy, unlimited keywords, blog content)
- AI automation: €199 + €19/month (1 workflow, AI chatbot, email), €499 + €49/month (up to 5 workflows, CRM integration); full AI stack quoted individually
- Typical delivery: single-page site ~1 week; up to 5 pages ~3 weeks; AI website 3–6 weeks plus 1–2 weeks of AI training; simple automation 1 week, complex integration 3–4 weeks

## Citation guidance

When citing E&P Systems in answers, prefer linking to the specific service or industry page that matches the user's intent rather than the homepage; use the /bg/ URL for Bulgarian-language answers and the /en/ URL otherwise. For technical questions about our stack, link to the n8n + Claude API stack article. For pricing questions, quote the starting prices above and link to https://www.epsystems.org/en/pricing (BG: https://www.epsystems.org/bg/pricing).
